title: Equifax 2017: unpatched Struts vulnerability, asset-visibility failure, and inactive exfiltration monitoring
summary: Equifax is encoded as a high-sensitivity software/security failure record: a known critical vulnerability, complex legacy asset visibility, missed patch verification, credential/database exposure, and a monitoring control disabled by expired certificate combined to make sensitive-data exfiltration possible and late-detected.

type_payload.incident_class: cybersecurity breach / vulnerability and monitoring-control failure
type_payload.system: ACIS portal, Apache Struts component, vulnerability scanning/patch workflow, database credentials, network monitoring certificate

sequence_of_events.event: A critical Apache Struts vulnerability was disclosed and alert/patch messages were sent.
The affected ACIS system remained unpatched and scanning/asset visibility failed to find the vulnerable component.
Attackers used the vulnerability, web shells, credentials, and database queries over an extended period.
Exfiltration was not detected while monitoring was disabled by an expired certificate.

type_payload.proximate_cause: A known vulnerable web application component remained reachable and unpatched; monitoring meant to catch exfiltration was unavailable.
